== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|He could hear his opponents nearing as he stood before [[Chieftain Utahein|Utahein]], whose nostrils flared at the tinge of blood that wafted through the air. He had one chance to do this right.}}

== Acquisition ==
=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the [[Ardent Glorious Brigandine (skin)|Ardent Glorious Brigandine skin]] or [[Glorious Hero's Brigandine]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[PvP Rank]] of 100 is required.
{{Sold by|id = 89168}}
